correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md defines filtration pair [v -> u] by unique earlier neighbor of v and uses downward closure, not all acyclic matchings. Its relative-order classification in each square gives the six local maximal edges AB, AC, CD, DE, EF, FB (C6); orders in distinct squares can be interleaved around common o. The only extra vertices pair o and cannot coexist. Their exact links are three-point sets joined with (m-1) three-edge paths; m>=2 makes each link collapsible, so successive vertex-star deletions are genuine elementary simplicial collapses. Join-of-circles topology and multiplicative face enumerator then follow. Boundary m=1 correctly excluded. Independent small-instance order enumeration at m=2 reproduced (1,16,76,132,72) including empty face and the predicted 72 facets; source verifier contains further m=1,3 checks but not used to infer m>=2 theorem. Sources: Git tree c2de5e04b37462c88930fb29704acb89143a9093 and RESULT.md Git blob 0aad6a413c2fde25013815f8e6c677279582855d, proof steps 1-4.; The m=2 independent 7! ordering enumeration and symbolic join/link enumerators agree with predicted face vector; proof, not finite enumeration, handles all m.

The shared-vertex effect invalidates the previously applicable disjoint join formula and gives a nontrivial all-m collapse plus exact face counts and sharp m=1 boundary. The uniform hexagon core and apex-link mechanism are reusable structural information, not a mere parameter substitution.
